name: Anthropology PhD
detailsNote: Current 2027–28 application date confirmed. Biological Anthropology is a subdiscipline of the Anthropology PhD; no separate application or admission model inferred.

deadlines.label: Application
deadlines.note: Current 2027–28 heading; supersedes older dates elsewhere on department pages.

applicationFee.note: Limited compelling-hardship requests through SAS application at least two weeks before deadline; departments cannot grant waivers. No nationality restriction stated; confirm international eligibility. No email requests or guaranteed waiver.

english.note: TOEFL/IELTS required for non-native international applicants unless current/prior school instruction in English or citizen of English-official country, per department. No TOEFL minimum. Central SAS page blocked; confirm current waiver approval and test details.

requirements.note: Writing sample highly recommended, maximum 25 pages excluding bibliography. Prior anthropology coursework not required. Research preparation and fit reviewed holistically. Biological Anthropology is an internal subdiscipline.

funding.note: Department admits PhDs only with full Graduate Division funding or documented equivalent external funding; external source must be shown during admissions review. No offer amount/duration established on page.
